_comment: Synthetic academic application profile (spec 101), the JSON half, matching config/application-profile.academic.example.md. Store YOURS with harrier --track <slug> profile put application_profile --file PATH.json. It positions the letter and the answers for a selection committee; every fact still comes from the truth documents.

strongest_evidence: reliable tools for data heavy groups
tests and validation the group can run
close work with the people who use the software

ai_tooling_workflow.real_example: Built a local automation that drafts application materials from verified truth sources with validation gates.

professional_stories.summary: Built an AI-assisted local automation pipeline with truth-source validation for application materials.

do_not_claim: Do not claim publications that are not in the truth sources
Do not claim teaching or supervision that is not in the truth sources
Do not claim grants or funding that are not in the truth sources

How do you use AI tools in your workflow.guidance: Name the actual tools and the real local automation example; do not inflate.

Why are you interested in this position?.guidance: Tie interest to the group's research as the call describes it, in the call's own words, and to verified work only.

selection_guidance: Write for a selection committee, not a recruiter.
Favor proof points that match the call's stated needs over the most impressive-sounding ones.

interest.short: I am interested in this position because the group's work needs reliable research software, which is the work I do.
interest.medium: I am interested in {company} because {product_signal}. The position fits my background: building reliable, tested tools and working closely with the people who use them.
notes: Use the call's language where it maps directly to verified experience.

fit.short: The position fits my background because my strongest work is reliable, tested software built with its users.
fit.medium: My background is strongest in building reliable, tested software and working closely with the people who use it. I would bring that care to the group's tools.

experience.short: My most relevant experience is building tested tools with validation gates.
experience.medium: I have built tools with validation gates and tests that others can run, and I keep claims tied to evidence.

leaving.short: I am looking for a position where research software is valued as part of the work.
leaving.medium: I am not leaving because of one specific issue. I am looking for a group where reliable research software is part of how the work gets done.

salary.short: My target is around EUR {salary_target}, depending on the position's grade and scope.
salary.medium: My target is around EUR {salary_target}, and I would usually look for at least EUR {salary_min}. I am open to discussing the grade and the full package.

availability.short: I can start conversations immediately and confirm a start date during the process.
availability.medium: I can start conversations immediately. I prefer to confirm notice and a start date once the process is clear.

generic.short: The position is close to work I have done well: reliable, tested software built with its users.
generic.medium: My background is most relevant where the position needs careful software work, close collaboration with researchers, and evidence for every claim.
